say:0:1910807001:1.text: So warm... the sound is gone... the pain is gone... I'm finally happy...
say:0:1910807001:1.source_cn: 好温暖……声音不在了，痛苦不在了……好快乐……

say:1:1910807002:1.text: The currents bless us... the currents bless us...
say:1:1910807002:1.source_cn: 洋流保佑……洋流保佑……洋流保佑……

say:2:1910807003:1.text: Take us to a happier place...
say:2:1910807003:1.source_cn: 带我们去……更幸福的地方……

say:3:1910807004:1.text: The Merfolk dissolve into motes of light, leaving only jumbled echoes. They whisper of happiness and devotion, yet the sound is bitter in your ears.
say:3:1910807004:1.source_cn: 海裔化作光点消散，只剩下混乱的残音。明明是幸福而虔诚的...
say:3:1910807004:1.male: The Merfolk dissolve into motes of light, leaving only jumbled echoes. They whisper of happiness and devotion, yet the sound is bitter in your ears.
say:3:1910807004:1.female: The Merfolk dissolve into motes of light, leaving only jumbled echoes. They whisper of happiness and devotion, yet the sound is bitter in your ears.

say:4:1910807005:1.text: You try to cast a protective barrier for the glowing motes, but to no avail. This spell can hold back the glowing tide, but it cannot hold back these drifting lights...
say:4:1910807005:1.source_cn: 你尝试着为光点释放防护罩，却无济于事。这种法术能挡住汹...
say:4:1910807005:1.male: You try to cast a protective barrier for the glowing motes, but to no avail. This spell can hold back the glowing tide, but it cannot hold back these drifting lights...
say:4:1910807005:1.female: You try to cast a protective barrier for the glowing motes, but to no avail. This spell can hold back the glowing tide, but it cannot hold back these drifting lights...
